verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms docs.stripe.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with agent-directed guidance. Another probe confirms clean Markdown versions of doc pages (e.g., billing.md), and the many .md-suffixed docs URLs show the agent-readable format applies site-wide. Missing for 10: no independent or community report of agents actually consuming these docs successfully, and only a fragment of the llms.txt content is shown, so its Billing coverage depth is unverified.
